description: Ask Last Price what pricing inputs are missing. Start with request: {}, return its questions to the caller, then send continuation.request and answers. Prepare is free and does not compute. When ready, action compute uses the existing authenticated pricing API; configure a credential first. Never invent answers or treat a continuation as authorization.

action.description: prepare (free) returns the questions still open; compute prices once nothing is missing.

answers.description: Answers to the questions the last call asked, by field, e.g. {"currency":"USD","unit_cost":4}.

request.description: Partial REST PricingComputeRequest, including nested context, constraints, an explicit function selection and options. Reuse continuation.request on subsequent calls.

name: pricing_conversation
